additional_info.subject: RE: ID0476164-DC/Si-D/IE- [Y2/T04002922622] Outlets are out of Order CRM:03289000438
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon,
The charger is back online now.
To be clear – this was a 320kW Gen 2 but we have removed two power modules from it, so it is now 240kW.
I have configured the PLC for fewer power modules like this:
DC1 – 2 modules in group
DC2 – 2 modules in group
DC3 – 1 modules in group
DC4 – 1 modules in group
The charger looks like it is working but there are still some error flags.
Can you please assess and let me know if the configuration is correct.
https://configuration.sicharge.technology/chargers/nzRxPv/error-flags
Thanks,
Jason

additional_info.subject: ID0476164-DC/Si-D/IE- [Y2/T04002922622] Outlets are out of Order CRM:03289000438
additional_info.body:
Dear
Jason,
Yes, the configuration looks correct based on the information provided. The PLC setup with the reduced number of power modules is aligned with the current 240 kW configuration.
we will proceed with closing the ticket. Please let us know if any issues reappear.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
